arxiv-1312-3606.title: Strong squeezing and robust entanglement in cavity electromechanics
arxiv-1312-3606.creator: Eyob A. Sete 1 and Hichem Eleuch 2
arxiv-1312-3606.description: A 2013 arXiv research paper by Eyob A. Sete 1 and Hichem Eleuch 2. We investigate nonlinear effects in an electromechanical system consisting of a superconducting charge qubit coupled to transmission line resonator and a nanomechanical oscillator, which in turn is coupled to another transmission line resonator. The nonlinearities induced by the superconducting qubit and the optomechanical coupling play an important role in creating optomechanical entanglement as well as the squeezing of the transmitted microwave field.

arxiv-1912-13450.title: A classical mechanical model of two interacting massless particles in de Sitter space and its quantization Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-1912-13450.creator: Naohiro Kanda, Satoshi Okano
arxiv-1912-13450.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Naohiro Kanda, Satoshi Okano. A conformally invariant model of two interacting massless particles in Minkowski space was proposed by Casalbuoni and Gomis [ 1 ] . We generalize this model to the case of de Sitter space from the perspective of geodesic distance, in such a way that the resulting, generalized action reduces to the original action in a limit that de Sitter radius goes to infinity.

arxiv-2103-14603.title: Dispersion-Minimizing Motion Primitives for Search-Based Motion Planning
arxiv-2103-14603.creator: Laura Jarin-Lipschitz, James Paulos, Raymond Bjorkman, Vijay Kumar
arxiv-2103-14603.description: Abstract Search-based planning with motion primitives is a powerful motion planning technique that can provide dynamic feasibility, optimality, and real-time computation times on size, weight, and power-constrained platforms in unstructured environments. However, optimal design of the motion planning graph, while crucial to the performance of the planner, has not been a main focus of prior work.

arxiv-2107-06859.title: A novel approach for modelling and classifying sit-to-stand kinematics using inertial sensors
arxiv-2107-06859.creator: Maitreyee Wairagkar
arxiv-2107-06859.description: Abstract \AppendGraphicsExtensions .tif Abstract Sit-to-stand transitions are an important part of activities of daily living and play a key role in functional mobility in humans. The sit-to-stand movement is often affected in older adults due to frailty and in patients with motor impairments such as Parkinson’s disease leading to falls.

arxiv-2208-00556.title: The integral Chow rings of the stacks of hyperelliptic Weierstrass points
arxiv-2208-00556.creator: Dan Edidin, Zhengning Hu
arxiv-2208-00556.description: Abstract . We compute the integral Chow rings of the stacks ℋ g , n w {\mathcal{H}}_{g,n}^{w} parametrizing hyperelliptic curves with n n marked hyperelliptic Weierstrass points. We prove that the integral Chow ring of each of these stacks is generated as an algebra by any of the ψ \psi -classes and that all relations live in degree one.

arxiv-2209-03574.title: Magnetic Effects Promote Supermassive Star Formation in Metal-enriched Atomic-cooling Halos
arxiv-2209-03574.creator: Shingo Hirano, Masahiro N. Machida, Shantanu Basu
arxiv-2209-03574.description: Abstract Intermediate-mass black holes (with ≥ 10 5 ​ M ⊙ \geq\!10^{5}\,M_{\odot} ) are promising candidates for the origin of supermassive black holes (with ∼ 10 9 ​ M ⊙ \sim\!10^{9}\,M_{\odot} ) in the early universe (redshift z ∼ 6 z\sim 6 ).

arxiv-2510-12128.title: nuGPR: GPU-Accelerated Gaussian Process Regression with Iterative Algorithms and Low-Rank Approximations Thanks: Submitted to the editors July 10, 2025.
arxiv-2510-12128.creator: Ziqi Zhao, Vivek Sarin
arxiv-2510-12128.description: Abstract Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) is an important type of supervised machine learning model with inherent uncertainty measure in its predictions. We propose a new framework, nuGPR, to address the well-known challenge of high computation cost associated with GPR training.

pmc-10625399.title: Trigeminal Ganglion Electrical Stimulation for Trigeminal Nerve Postherpetic Neuralgia: A Retrospective Study
pmc-10625399.creator: Mengzhen Xu, Jin Liu, Hui Zhang, Ruiting Li, Junni Wei

pmc-11389683.title: Synthesis, crystal structure and Hirshfeld surface of ethyl 2-[2-(methyl­sulfan­yl)-5-oxo-4,4-diphenyl-4,5-di­hydro-1H-imidazol-1-yl]acetate (thio­phenytoin derivative)

pmc-11389683.description: The di­hydro­imidazole ring in the title mol­ecule is slightly distorted and the lone pair on the tri-coordinate nitro­gen atom is involved in intra-ring π bonding. In the crystal, C—H⋯O hydrogen bonds form inversion dimers, which are connected along the a- and c-axis directions by additional C—H⋯O hydrogen bonds, forming layers parallel to the ac plane.

pmc-11480317.title: Public agreement with misinformation about wind farms
pmc-11480317.creator: Kevin Winter, Matthew J Hornsey, Lotte Pummerer, Kai Sassenberg
pmc-11480317.description: Misinformation campaigns target wind farms, but levels of agreement with this misinformation among the broader public are unclear. Across six nationally quota-based samples in the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia (total N = 6008), over a quarter of respondents agree with half or more of contrarian claims about wind farms.

pmc-11610354.title: Photobiomodulation for diabetes and its complications: a review of general presentation, mechanisms and efficacy
pmc-11610354.creator: Keyan Wang, Hongwei Zhao, Xiaoqing Zhao, Xiaoyu Zhang, Wei Zhang, Yan Cheng, Jingyan Ge
pmc-11610354.description: Diabetes mellitus is a metabolic disease that is marked by persistent hyperglycemia due to inadequate insulin secretion or insulin resistance. Its prevalence is increasing yearly. Diabetes mellitus can lead to serious health complications that are the primary cause of mortality and disability among diabetic patients, including diabetic retinopathy, diabetic foot ulcers, diabetic peripheral neuropathy, and diabetic periodontitis, and so on.

pmc-11618071.title: The global distribution and drivers of wood density and their impact on forest carbon stocks
pmc-11618071.creator: Lidong Mo, Thomas W Crowther, Daniel S Maynard, Johan van den Hoogen, Haozhi Ma, Lalasia Bialic-Murphy, Jingjing Liang, Sergio de-Miguel, Gert-Jan Nabuurs, Peter B Reich, Oliver L Phillips, Meinrad Abegg, Yves C Adou Yao, Giorgio Alberti, Angelica M Almeyda Zambrano, Braulio Vilchez Alvarado, Esteba
pmc-11618071.description: The density of wood is a key indicator of the carbon investment strategies of trees, impacting productivity and carbon storage. Despite its importance, the global variation in wood density and its environmental controls remain poorly understood, preventing accurate predictions of global forest carbon stocks. Here we analyse information from 1.

pmc-12605782.title: Metabolic Adaptations of Benthic Forams: Foraminiferal Species Adaptations to Intertidal Mudflat Assessed by a Metabolic Approach
pmc-12605782.creator: Julia Courtial, Jeremy Lothier, Caroline Cukier, Anis M Limami, Emmanuelle Geslin
pmc-12605782.description: Benthic foraminifera are characterized by their rapid response and high resistance to variable and extreme conditions such as those typically found in intertidal environments. However, knowledge of cellular and metabolic adaptations by foraminifera remains incomplete. Here we explore the metabolic profile of three species from an intertidal mudflat: Haynesina germanica (kleptoplast, mixotrophic), Elphidium oceanense, and Ammonia confertitesta (heterotrophic).

pmc-12658281.title: Integration of Multi‐Cereals Into Wheat Flour: Nutritional Composition, Dough Rheology, and Sensory Profile of Composite Breads
pmc-12658281.creator: Farooq Hafeez, Muhammad Tauseef Sultan, Hassan Raza, Muhammad Usman Khalid, Ali Ikram, Muhammad Tayyab Arshad, Iqra Baig, Sidra Imtiaz, Muhammad Abrar, Ali Imran, Kodjo Théodore Gnedeka
pmc-12658281.description: Bread, one of the most widely consumed staple foods, is traditionally prepared from whole wheat flour owing to its high gluten content and desirable physiochemical properties. However, growing consumer demand for nutrient‐dense functional foods has prompted researchers to explore composite flour formulations by integrating minor cereals such as barley, oat, corn, millet and sorghum.

pmc-12909189.title: Studies on the functionality of the TC-NER ERCC6-M1097V protein variant frequently found in Louisiana patients with PCa upon UV damage
pmc-12909189.creator: Oluwatobi Ogundepo, Arrigo De Benedetti
pmc-12909189.description: ERCC6, also known as CSB (Cockayne Syndrome B), is a key protein involved in transcription-coupled nucleotide excision repair (TC-NER), a DNA repair process that removes lesions blocking RNA polymerase. ERCC6’s multifaceted roles include chromatin remodeling, transcription regulation, oxidative stress response, and coordination with other DNA repair proteins.

pmc-13474709.title: Epidemiological investigation of Chandipura virus disease outbreak, Gujarat, India, July 2024: a matched case-control study
pmc-13474709.creator: Amit Pritam Swain, Betsy Varghese, Sowntappan Balasubramanian, Ngangom Kanchan, Aathira V Dev, Kamlesh Mandriya, Jariwala Devang Ashvinkumar, Jayesh M Katira, Harshad P Prajapati, Jayesh Solanki, Nilam Patel, Ramesh Chandra, Himanshu Chauhan, Atul Goel, Tanzin Dikid
pmc-13474709.description: BackgroundChandipura virus disease (CHPVD), caused by the sandfly-transmitted Chandipura virus, is a major public health concern due to its reported explosive outbreaks of Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) and high mortality in children. We aimed to describe the clinico-epidemiological characteristics of the cases and identify risk factors, following laboratory confirmation of CHPVD in Gujarat, India, in July 2024.

pmc-13671700.title: Fabrication of end-coated fibre-optic ultrasound transmitters
pmc-13671700.creator: Semyon Bodian, Shaoyan Zhang, Nyma Nassren, Edward Z Zhang, Paul C Beard, Richard J Colchester, Adrien E Desjardins, Erwin J Alles
pmc-13671700.description: Obliquely emitting fibre-optic optical ultrasound (OpUS) probes show strong potential for guiding minimally invasive procedures, but the imprecise coating methods used to date deposit excess coating along the side of the fibre, which has been suspected to cause imaging artefacts. In this study, we aimed to confirm the source of these artefacts and to introduce an alternative coating method.
